negative_reviews.author: Tracey Smith
negative_reviews.text: Came here with my son. Ordered goyoza,  ramen chicken/noodle dish and green dragon roll. I asked for a coconut mango matcha latte but was told they didnt have any, dispite flyers on every table advertising it. I then asked for a lychee juice (something I have everytime I visit your aberdeen store), server didn't know and would have to check. My sons ramen came and it was missing the pork and I never got a drink to have with my food, not by choice. When we asked for containers to take the food home they didn't bring enough and we had to ask for one more for my sons ramen. We didnt get a bag, we were not offered so as we were carrying out 4 containers of food someone not in uniform asked us if we would like a bag. If this had been my first experience in a maki and ramen I would not hurry back. But within the last 7 days I have been to your aberdeen store, here everything is exceptional especially the staff and service. I have also visited your Leith store, which was good. We were told the visit today was below par because the staff were new!

negative_reviews.text:
We had lunch today, booked in advance but we had to queue outside. We were in 2 but were served 10/15mins apart, no drinks were served until we reminded about them. Food was tasty and nice but lukewarm, dessert (creme brulee) was lovely. At some point after lunch we were asked to leave as the table was booked,  which is fine but why not offering us to move to a non-booked table given that the majority were empty?! Maybe short of staff but no apologies offered.
Will not book again.

Had to wait double the waiting time what my friends had, gave me the wrong food the first time, and when they got it right, the cha siu is warm at best. The bamboo is too salty as well.

At least the vibes are good. And I got 1 more cha siu for the wait. But the quality doesn't help.

For the 21 quid I spent this only worth 1 star.

negative_reviews.author: E R
negative_reviews.text:
The ramen was quite delightful, however there is one major concern. The hygiene/cleanliness of the glassses.

The glasses we received had varying cleanliness, the first glass ( the solo one shown in the image) was quite dirty. It had grime left on it, at first we thought it was because of the ice however it did not go away. It is just dissapointing considering that the food was excellent and the atmosphere is perfect.

negative_reviews.author: Ann Roberts
negative_reviews.text: First visit. I  ordered steak ramen the menu stated medium rare. It came very well done and broth was lukewarm. I sent it back. The waitress said the chef is preparing you a fresh one. It came back 2 minutes later steak was overdone and tough. It had obviously been nooked and reheated in a microwave. My daughter ordered the chicken Laksa and complained that the chicken was compressed sliced chicken not good for value for £18.50.  We complained to the manager. She said she had no idea whether the chicken came in prepacked or ready cooked. She said we would not have to pay. We would have refused anyway as we had one mouthful each. The Manager offered us complimentary cocktails or desserts we refused and she gave us £40 vouchers which we still haven't used. Considering they are just up from Waggamommas they have strong competition and honestly not a patch on Waggas they really need to to their game.

negative_reviews.author: J Len
negative_reviews.text:
our first server didn’t set table for us and then once we sat down didn’t attend to us until flagged down 20 minutes later
Thankfully, Amidu, saved the day by being very attentive, apologised and help fix the orders that had been written down wrong (chicken given to veggies etc)

also on a more positive note, GREAT vegan black garlic tonkotsu ramen. best i’ve had.

negative_reviews.author: Mia
negative_reviews.text:
The first server seated us to our table and took ages to come back and serve us. We had to ask her to take our order because we were waiting for over 20 minutes. She got our order completely wrong and we had the wrong ramen delivered and she also ordered us chicken gyozas instead of veggie (we are vegetarians). She also hadn’t set the table so once the food did arrive, we had to try and find cutlery/napkins ourselves.
Luckily and thankfully, Amidu took over and he helped to rectify things. He was really kind and helpful; great customer service from him!

The food tasted nice but maybe not be the best place for vegans and vegetarians as you may accidentally be given meat.

negative_reviews.author: Mari K
negative_reviews.text: Had lunch here a while ago and was excited because of the raving reviews. Honestly not sure how they got these as the foods was extremely mediocre. Just another influencer spot that has the looks but not the goods. Staff was super lovely but clearly understaffed and a little unsure of how to handle busy periods. London has to stop with these inauthentic, mediocre, money grabbing places and needs to go back to prioritising businesses with unique, original and passion led cuisine.

negative_reviews.author: Marvin Anthony Edmead
negative_reviews.text: This was a bit ‘meh’ to be completely honest. The squid starter was bland and uninteresting. The ramen was good but not good enough considering the range of other options. Sadly, the service was friendly but not attentive enough. We had higher expectations. Too high? Maybe.

negative_reviews.author: manesh Patel
negative_reviews.text: Went there nearly 2 weeks ago for a birthday. Used their 50% off food discount. Atmosphere was pretty good and so was the food. Service however was astonishingly poor on the day. Apparently some staff didn't turn up and even though the place wasn't busy, it was one staff member for the entire resturant. This meant food and service was significantly delayed and some luke warm food served. This isn't the fault of the staff memeber. However we also realised after paying and leaving the venue that the discount applied was incorrect and i have been over charged. Tried emailing and calling to get this resolved with proof of reciept. No answer. Please get in touch with me to resolve! Been nearly 2 weeks now and still unresolved.
